questions: What kinds of clothes do people in your country typically wear? Are there different clothes for work and for play? Tell me about the clothes in your country.
What kinds of clothes do you like to wear personally? What are you wearing today? What kind of fashion style do you like? Give me all the details about your fashion style.
본인이 좋아하는 옷과 패션 스타일 묘사
Fashions is always changing. Tell me about the kinds of clothes that were popular when you were younger. What did the styles look like? How are they different from what is popular now?
어렸을 때 유행했던 패션과 지금 패션 비교
What do you do when you go to buy new clothes? Where do you go? Who do you go with? Tell me everything about what you do when you buy new clothes.
본인이 평소 옷을 사러 갈 때 하는 일들 묘사
What do you do when you go shopping? Where do you go and what do you look for? Tell me about your typical shopping habits in detail.
Tell me about the last time you bought a new piece of clothing. What did you need and where did you find it? Were there any challenges or problems? Give me all the details.
본인이 옷 사러 갔던 경험 혹은 겪은 문제 묘사
Tell me about the banks in your country. What do they typically look like? Where are they usually located?
Tell me about the kinds of things you usually do when you go to the bank.
본인이 은행에 가서 하는 업무 묘사
Banks have definitely changed over time. Tell me about a bank you remember from your childhood. What was the bank like? How was it different from banks today?
어렸을 때 은행과 지금 은행과의 비교

Sometimes, problems arise when dealing with the bank. Tell me in detail about a problem you had that involved your bank. Maybe the bank was closed when you needed it to be open. Maybe the bank made some kind of mistake. Tell me the story of a time when you had to solve a problem involving your bank.
은행 업무 관련 본인이 겪은 문제와 해결 방법 설명
Tell me about the hotels in your country. What are those places like?
Tell me what you typically do when you go to a hotel. What do you do first, second, et cetera? When do you usually stay at hotels?
호텔에 도착해서 하는 일들과 언제 투숙하는지 설명

People often have memories of especially beautiful and interesting hotels. Tell me about a hotel that you remember for some reason. Where was it? What did it look like? Describe it for me in as much detail as possible.
기억에 남는 호텔 묘사와 기억에 남는 이유 설명
When was the last time you stayed in a hotel? Tell me the whole story of where you were, why you were there and what you did there. Take me through the whole hotel stay from start to finish.

questions: People often have appointments for different things. Tell me about the kinds of places you go for different appointments.
본인이 평소에 하는 예약 종류들 묘사
What kinds of things do you do when you make appointments? Tell me what you exactly do when you make these appointments.
본인이 평소에 예약을 하는 방법 구체적으로 묘사

Tell me about an appointment you remember from your childhood. Maybe you visited a doctor, the dentist, or a new school. Tell me about the place you went to for this appointment. What were your impressions? How did you feel?
본인이 어렸을 때 했던 예약 경험 묘사

Sometimes, funny or surprising things happen during an appointment. Tell me about an appointment that you remember for some reason. Tell me everything that happened and why this appointment was so memorable.
예약 관련 기억에 남는 본인 경험 설명
Tell me about some places people in your country like to spend their free time. Do they visit parks, beaches or other places? What are some popular free time locations?
우리나라 사람들이 자유시간에 가는 장소들 묘사
What do people in your country like to do in their free time? What are some popular free time activities?
우리나라 사람들이 자유시간에 하는 일들 묘사
Do you have more or less free time now than you did in the past? Describe for me how your free time has changed over time.
Tell me about the last time you had some free time. What did you do? Who did you spend your free time with? Tell me everything that happened the last time you had some free time.
최근 자유시간에 본인이 한 일 설명
Can you describe a friend or a family member you see often? Who is he or she? What is he or she like?
Describe two different friends or family members. Describe each of them in as much detail as you can. And then, tell me about the similarities they have in common and the differences between them.
When you get together with friends or family, what kinds of things do you like to do together and why?
가족/친구를 만나면 주로 하는 일들 묘사

When you get together with friends or family, what are some of the topics or interests you discuss? Why are these things of interest or concern? How do these things affect your life? Please explain in as much detail as you can.
Tell me about the last time when you got together with your friends or family. Who was there and when was it? Tell me everything you did that day from beginning to end.
Could you tell me about a special event or a holiday you celebrated with your family or friends? Tell me all about that event or the holiday from beginning to end.
가족/친구와 보낸 특별했던 이벤트 또는 휴일 설명
Tell me about visits to a friend’s or a family member’s house. What do you normally do when you go there?
가족/친구의 집에 방문해서 하는 일들 묘사
Talk about a visit to a friend or a family member in your childhood. Who did you visit and whom did you go with? What do you remember about that visit? What made the visit special?
가족/친구 집에 어렸을 때 방문했던 경험 묘사
Talk about a time when you visited a friend or a family member. What did you do when you visited them? What was memorable about that visit? Tell me everything from beginning to end.
가족/친구의 집에 최근 방문했던 경험 묘사
Tell me about some popular holidays in your country. Where do people typically celebrate their holidays? What kinds of things do they use to celebrate?
우리나라 사람들이 휴일을 보내는 장소/활동 묘사
Choose one of the holidays you just told me about. Tell me all of the things people typically do to celebrate this holiday. What activities are involved?
위에 언급한 휴일에 사람들이 하는 일들 상세히 묘사
Describe for me a special holiday memory that you have from your childhood. Tell me where you were and what the place looked like and everything you remember from the holiday scene.
어렸을 때 특별했던 휴일 관련 추억 설명
Tell me in detail about the last holiday that you celebrated. Did anything special or memorable happen? Tell me everything you did to celebrate this most recent holiday.
가장 최근 휴일에 했던 일들 자세히 묘사
What are some holidays in your country? What do people do during these holidays? What is special about them?
우리나라 휴일 종류와 휴일에 사람들이 하는 일들 묘사
What are some issues or concerns people have regarding holidays? What do people do to address those issues or concerns?
